page.overview:
Who is Nitro-Viper?

{| class="wikitable" style="border-collapse:collapse;"

!style="border:1px solid black" colspan=2|Generation 1

Nitro-Viper was the action figure bundled with the Detonator vehicle for 1993's vehicle lineup. The figure's entire mold was taken from the Track-Viper. ----

Appearance: orange helmet with silver face shield; black shirt with orange armor on chest and arms; black gloves; orange pants; silver kneepads and boots
